name: Hand and Foot
description: Hand and Foot is a popular Canasta-style rummy game typically played by four players in partnerships. Each player receives two sets of cards: a 'hand' (played first) and a 'foot' (played after the hand is depleted). The objective is to form melds and canastas (7-card melds) while managing special cards like Red Threes (bonus) and Black Threes (penalty). Features 'books' (clean and dirty canastas), minimum meld requirements that increase each round, and strategic decisions about when to go out.

content.text: Hand and Foot is a popular Canasta-style rummy game typically played by four players in partnerships. Each player receives two sets of cards: a 'hand' (played first) and a 'foot' (played after the hand is depleted). The objective is to form melds and canastas (7-card melds) while managing special cards like Red Threes (bonus) and Black Threes (penalty). Features 'books' (clean and dirty canastas), minimum meld requirements that increase each round, and strategic decisions about when to go out.
Developed in the United States as a variant of Canasta, adding the unique 'hand and foot' mechanic where players manage two separate sets of cards.
2-6 players. Best with 4 in partnerships (partners sit opposite).
5-6 standard 52-card decks + Jokers (typically 5 decks for 4 players).
Two denominations of chips or counters for scoring.

Each player receives TWO sets of cards: Hand (11-15 cards) and Foot (11-15 cards face-down). Remaining cards form the stock. Top card turned face-up to start discard pile (if Red Three or Wild, bury it and turn another).

items.text: Different Minimum Meld Requirements: Some variants use different point thresholds for initial melds per round.
Variations in Canasta Requirements: Some require 2 clean + 1 dirty canasta to go out, or other combinations.
Different Card Values: Some play with different card values or penalties.
